item.text: The reference appears to be a round rod bent into a tight U, with equal-length legs and flat ends. I’m building that shape first to check its proportions and orientation. [Live CAD view](http://127.0.0.1:8770/#part.FCStd).
The four-view comparison shows that one leg is shorter. I’ve adjusted the lengths and confirmed the bend lies in the XZ plane; I’m checking the final render and single-solid validation now.
Created `submission.step` and verified it is one valid solid.
